name: Cannabidiol
summary: Cannabidiol carries an editorial Grade B rating, but the studies recorded on this profile do not demonstrate that grade. Recorded activity centres on endocannabinoid modulation, 5-HT1A activity and TRPV1 activation, which describes mechanism rather than demonstrated benefit. Noted cautions include liver.
description: Cannabidiol is cataloged as phytocannabinoid. Reported mechanisms: endocannabinoid modulation; 5-HT1A activity; TRPV1 activation.
safetyNotes: diarrhea, fatigue/sedation; CYP3A4/CYP2C19 interactions; elevated liver enzymes dose-dependent
